# Spec Sanity Checklist: Brave Search MCP Service

**Purpose**: Lightweight author pre-planning pass — highest-risk requirements-quality checks across the full spec before `/speckit.tasks`
**Created**: 2026-08-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Consistency & Dependencies

- [ ] CHK001 - Do US1, FR-002, and the "Search Credential" key entity all state the same key-custody model after the FR-002 amendment (deployment config only, app never handles the key)? [Consistency, Spec §US1, §FR-002, §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the key-rotation edge case ("user updates the credential in one place; connection resumes") still consistent with the amended custody model, including whether a companion-only restart is required and permitted by FR-005? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-005]

## Clarity & Measurability

- [ ] CHK003 - Is "unobtrusive unavailability notice" (FR-006, SC-005) defined specifically enough to be judged — placement, persistence, wording — or does it remain subjective? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK004 - Does SC-002 define the test protocol — who constructs the 20-question set, what counts as "answered correctly", and what makes a source "current"? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is the SC-004 comparison baseline ("the equivalent reply without search") defined — same question, same model, connection toggled off — so the ≤10 s delta is reproducible? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK006 - Does SC-001's 2-minute window state whether editing stack config and (re)starting the companion is inside or outside the measured span? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is "actionable diagnostics" (FR-007) elaborated per failure mode — i.e., what each diagnostic must tell the user (unreachable vs invalid credential vs quota/rate limit)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]

## Completeness & Coverage

- [ ] CHK008 - Are citation display requirements complete for large result sets — a cap, deduplication, or "top N" rule — given SC-003 demands 100% of used sources be visible? [Gap, Spec §FR-004, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are privacy requirements specified for query content — must the user be able to know that conversation queries leave the network to the external search provider? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are model-behavior requirements (US2: "discrepancy is acknowledged"; Edge Cases: "model says so" on zero results) phrased as verifiable outcomes rather than discretionary behavior? [Measurability, Spec §US2, §Edge Cases]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Context for CHK001/CHK002: the FR-002 amendment history is documented in `research.md` §R-2
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
